question: Does the bound source name a document it requires and that no bound source supplies?
answer: YES. Three sets of insert pages, named by the bound source on three of its own pages.
whyThisIsNotAComeleteneessCounter: The nine packet-completeness counters measure the blanks on the pages that ARE in the bound binary. They cannot see a page that is absent, so all nine can be zero while the packet is unfilable. This record exists so that fact is stated rather than inferred.
consequenceForThisFamily: COMPONENT_SET is an OPEN FINDING for this family. The packet is built, deterministic and internally complete, and it is not a filing until the insert forms are added.
whatWouldCloseIt: A source lane acquiring the Coalition for Court Access Non Conviction Insert Forms and binding them to this family, after which the Facts, Findings and Exhibit pages become part of the rendered packet.

missing.namedBy: the bound source's own printed pages
missing.printedInstruction: Take out this page and insert your non-conviction Facts pages (from the Non Conviction Insert Forms)
missing.where: page 5 of the bundle, inside the Verified Petition, between paragraph 3 and the WHEREFORE clause
missing.whatIsMissing: CCA Non Conviction Insert Forms — Facts pages
missing.consequence: The petition as delivered has no factual allegations about the arrest, charge or allegation being expunged. It cannot be filed as it stands.

missing.namedBy: the bound source's own printed pages
missing.printedInstruction: Take out this page and insert your non-conviction Findings pages (from the Non Conviction Insert Forms)
missing.where: page 10 of the bundle, inside the proposed order, after finding 3
missing.whatIsMissing: CCA Non Conviction Insert Forms — Findings pages
missing.consequence: The proposed order has no findings for the court to adopt.

missing.namedBy: the bound source's own printed pages
missing.printedInstruction: Take out this page and insert your non-conviction Exhibit pages (from the Non Conviction Insert Forms)
missing.where: page 11 of the bundle, inside the proposed order
missing.whatIsMissing: CCA Non Conviction Insert Forms — Exhibit pages
missing.consequence: Exhibit A, which the order's own paragraph 1(a) says carries "all information necessary to identify particular agency records that are to be expunged pursuant to this Order" as I.C. § 35-38-9-1(g) requires, is absent.

whereTheParticipantGetsThem.why: Every page of this bundle carries that address in its own footer, beside "Approved by the Coalition for Court Access", so the participant is sent to the body that publishes the missing insert forms rather than to a search.

disclosedToTheParticipant: participant-instructions.md opens with this, before anything else, and tells the participant not to file without them.
